YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR MACHINE
Local CAS → preview → reconcile → commit → review
Complete-vision design · no parser or portfolio response is simulated
One-use password. Raw file never goes to an AI provider. Only reviewed transactions enter the local ledger.

proposed rebalance without placing an order.
